_note: This file names npm, pnpm, npx and yarn in order to deny them. check-package-manager:allow-names

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; [ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] || exit 0; f=$(realpath -m "$f" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; r=$(realpath -m "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$f" in "$r"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.mts|*.cts|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.jsonc|*.css) cd "$r" && bunx @biomejs/biome format --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; [ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] || exit 0; f=$(realpath -m "$f" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; r=$(realpath -m "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$f" in "$r"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in */package-lock.json|*/pnpm-lock.yaml|*/yarn.lock|*/npm-shrinkwrap.json) echo "Blocked by AGENTS.md section 8: bun.lock is the only permitted lockfile. Delete $f and use bun install / bun ci." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; grep -qF "check-package-manager:allow-names" "$f" 2>/dev/null && exit 0; l='(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])'; v='(install|add|ci|run|exec|test|start|build|create|init|i|publish|uninstall|remove|audit|update|upgrade|link|unlink|version|ls|list|pack|dedupe|rebuild|outdated|config|why|workspace|workspaces|dlx)'; m=$(grep -inE "${l}(npm|pnpm|yarn)[[:space:]]+${v}([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)|${l}(npx|pnpx)[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]|${l}yarn[[:space:]]*$" "$f" 2>/dev/null | head -3); [ -z "$m" ] && exit 0; printf 'AGENTS.md section 8 violation in %s - Bun is the only package manager. Use bun install / bun add / bun ci / bun run / bunx instead.\n%s\n' "$f" "$m" >&2; exit 2

i=$(cat); [ "$(printf '%s' "$i" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false' 2>/dev/null)" = "true" ] && exit 0; t=$(printf '%s' "$i" | jq -r '.transcript_path // ""' 2>/dev/null); [ -f "$t" ] || exit 0; e=$(jq -r '.message.content[]? | select(.type=="tool_use") | .name' "$t" 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '^(Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit)$'); [ "${e:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null || exit 0; c=$(jq -r '.message.content[]? | select(.type=="tool_use" and .name=="Bash") | .input.command // "" | split("\n")[0]' "$t" 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '^[[:space:]]*(cd [^&;|]+ (&&|;) )?bun run check([[:space:]]|$)'); [ "${c:-0}" -gt 0 ] && exit 0; echo 'Files were edited this session but the AGENTS.md section 30 blocking suite was never run. Run `bun run check` and report the real result, then close with the section 51 format (## Completed / ## Decisions / ## Validation / ## Files changed / ## Risks / limitations / ## Deferred). Do not conceal a failing check.' >&2; exit 2
